Nandini Patodia

+91- 7038930565, patodianandini@gmail.com , LinkedIn

Skills & Tools

Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, User Stories, Business Process Mapping, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Management, UAT, Sprint Planning. PI Planning, Competitive Planning, BRD, FRD Technical: SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel, Python, API Integration, Data Visualization, AWS, Azure Tools: Azure Devops, Jira, Miro, Figma, SharePoint. Advanced Excel, Office 365 Product/Project: Agile/Scrum, Backlog Management, PRD, Wireframing (Figma), Roadmapping, KPI Tracking Soft Skills: Problem-Solving, Communication, Critical Thinking, Collaboration, Attention to Detail Professional Experience

LTIMindtree, Senior Business Analyst (Bangalore, India)

Aug 2021 – July 2026

Project 1: American Express Global Business Travel

Worked as part of an Agile product team, driving requirement refinement, feature creation, prioritization, and backlog grooming in JIRA, ensuring alignment with business objectives and sprint goals by created crisp BRDs and FRDs. • Used Miro boards during PI Planning to collaborate with product, engineering, data, and operations teams, visualizing dependencies, breaking epics into features, and aligning deliverables for upcoming quarters.

Performed deep data analysis using SQL on AWS Redshift to validate business logic, identify trends in travel/spend patterns, and support decision-making for enterprise travel solutions.

Developed and enhanced Power BI dashboards to track KPIs like spend optimization, policy compliance, traveller trends, and process performance, enabling data-backed product improvements.

Led UAT planning, test case creation, and defect triage, ensuring user readiness and high-quality releases for key product enhancements across global markets. Project 2: S&P Global

Acted as a core member of the Agile product team, driving user story development, acceptance criteria definition, and backlog prioritization in Azure DevOps (ADO) for Capital IQ Pro enhancements.

Facilitated PI Planning sessions using Miro, designing product workflows, mapping feature dependencies, and aligning cross-functional teams on quarterly objectives and delivery milestones.

Utilized SQL to validate financial datasets, support impact assessments, and ensure high-quality data for market intelligence workflows along with API (JSON, XML) for data validations.

Created internal analytics dashboards and product usage insights using Power BI, enabling data-driven product decisions and enhancement prioritization.

Led end-to-end UAT cycles, coordinating with QA, product managers, and engineering to ensure stable releases, accurate data delivery, and improved platform usability with zero major production defects.

Used Pandas and Numpy to gain insights on market trends analysis for top listed companies on Capital IQ Pro. Leveraged components like Bid Price, Ask Price etc to showcase field wise trends using Matplotlib

Feb 2021 – Jun 2021 • Assisted in requirements gathering, data analysis, and stakeholder coordination for internal process improvement

Tata Consultancy Services, Intern, (Nagpur, India)

initiatives, supporting the product team with clear documentation and actionable insights.

Contributed to test case preparation and UAT execution, identifying gaps, validating functionalities, and ensuring smooth delivery of enhancements in an Agile environment. Projects

Nov 2024 – Dec 2024 • Built a Power BI dashboard to analyze sales KPIs, enabling data-driven decisions on product, city, delivery performance. • Identified revenue drivers and operational gaps through data transformation and trends, supporting business strategy. Google Search Analysis

Blinkit Sales Analysis Dashboard

Mar 2022 – Jun 2022

Analyzed search patterns and keyword clusters to uncover user intent and opportunities for improved visibility. • Delivered insights by processing and segmenting large text datasets, enabling better SEO and content planning decisions. Certifications

AWS Cloud Practioner • Microsoft Certified Data Analyst PL-300 • Databricks Gen AI Badge • SQL Advanced (Hackerrank) Education

Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics Design Technology

Aug 2017 – Jun 2021

Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering & Management, Nagpur, India (Silver Medallist)
